description: Horario del servicio de bus taxi - Ayuntamiento de Usurbil is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Diputación Foral de Gipuzkoa. Auzoetara eta baserrietara garraio publikorik ez iristeak eta, kasu batzuetan, gidabaimenik ez izateak isolamendu arazoak sortzen dituela ikusi ondoren, Usurbilgo Udalak, BEHEMENDI Elkartearen laguntzarekin, herritarren mugikortasuna errazteko zerbitzu berri hau jarri du martxan: auzoetan eta nekazal ingurunean bizi-kalitatea hobetzeko BUS-TAXI zerbitzua. The publisher named on the listing is Diputación Foral de Gipuzkoa. Its keywords include ordutegia, garraioa, bus. The listing shows 4 download or service links in SPREADSHEET, CSV. The listing shows 2016-01-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
